takes.h: Keep the dust jacket out of the sun
takes.p: Every collector learns this once, the expensive way. Spines fade on a bright wall faster than you would believe. Shelve your best hardcovers out of direct light, or behind archival covers, and keep the sunny shelf for the reading copies that can take it.

takes.h: The local shop is part of the archive
takes.p: The used bookshop that still has a horror section is doing preservation work nobody pays it for. Buy something every time you go in, even something small. The shop's survival is worth more to this hobby than any single book on its shelves.

takes.h: Toys are a gateway, not a threat
takes.p: Some collectors sneer at the figure aisle. I would rather thank it. A kid who owns a monster figure is a kid who might one day go looking for the film, and then the novel, and then the pulp it came from. Every collection starts somewhere.
